messages:
Maya (Finance): Heads up — NetSuite ingest just created ~120 duplicate credit memos from our nightly reconciliation job. Spotted during monthly close checks, customer totals off.
Lucy (Billing Ops): Ugh. Which job emitted the events?
Maya (Finance): The billing-reporter backfill ran at 03:12 UTC and re-queued a bunch of invoice.updated events to the event bus. DLQ has many invoice.updated entries reprocessed.
Sam (Eng): Was the backfill supposed to requeue events? I thought it wrote directly to the reconciliation table.
Maya (Finance): It re-published to the bus to trigger downstream fixes for a sync gap. Looks like those re-publishes didn't include stripe_event_id/idempotency metadata.
Sam (Eng): Can you paste a log line?
Maya (Finance): Sure:
```
INFO 2026-11-02T03:12:34Z requeue event_id=evt_1JN9xK type=invoice.updated payload.invoice.id=inv_ABC123 retries=0
```
Lucy (Billing Ops): The NetSuite consumer dedupes on external_id+amount, not on stripe_event_id. If event_id missing, we create a new credit memo when status toggles.
Hao (NetSuite SRE): Confirmed — netsuite-sync checks ns_external_id and amount. We previously added stripe_event_id dedupe but the backfill used old publisher lib.
Sam (Eng): Ok immediate steps: 1) Pause netsuite-sync consumer, 2) revert the backfill requeue, 3) run a dedupe + reconciliation script in NetSuite sandbox, 4) patch netsuite consumer to always check stripe_event_id.
Lucy (Billing Ops): Pausing consumer now. /pause job netsuite-sync-prod -> OK :white_check_mark:
stripe-bot: webhook retry count spike detected for /hooks/netsuite endpoint (429 responses)
Maya (Finance): A subset of duplicates are credit memos created when invoice moved from draft->open->paid; downstream logic treats invoice.updated as additive. We need safer state transitions.
Sam (Eng): I'm opening a rollback PR to stop the requeue behavior and to pin the publisher lib to v1.4.0 (which sets stripe_event_id).
Sam (Eng): Rolling back backfill publish — deploying now.
deploy-bot: deploy started: billing-reporter revert by @sam (sha: a1b2c3)
Sam (Eng): Deployed to prod, verified no new requeues for 25m. Event bus rate normalized.
Lucy (Billing Ops): I'll run the dedupe script against sandbox first, then prod after finance signs off. Need NetSuite sandbox write access.
Sam (Eng): Granted ns-sandbox access to lucy@redwood.com.
Hao (NetSuite SRE): For the consumer patch: I'll add stripe_event_id dedupe + a guard that ignores invoice.updated if invoice.status hasn't changed meaningfully. Will target a hotfix today.
Maya (Finance): For short-term: hold collections for affected customers and flag invoices for manual review. I'll draft an FYI for CS.
Lucy (Billing Ops): Drafted email to CS + accounting with list of affected accounts, sending now.
Sam (Eng): Root cause: backfill used billing-reporter v1.3.2 which doesn't set stripe_event_id on requeued messages. I missed the upgrade step when running the backfill. Adding checklist to runbook.
Maya (Finance): Please share final numbers once dedupe completes. We need to correct P&L impact for the close.
Lucy (Billing Ops): Will run de-dupe tonight and post summary here. :thumbsup:
Sam (Eng): Also adding monitoring: alert when backfill publishes >10k events without stripe_event_id.
Maya (Finance): Thanks all — appreciate the fast response.
